rationale: The plan correctly refuses to refit a count model and instead builds a full ranked list of every tested gene from the DESeq2 Wald statistic, with an explicit justification for that metric over shrunken LFC or signed log-p, and it excludes only genes with a missing stat — though it never states a tie-breaking rule. The enrichment specification is essentially reference-grade: local, version-named MSigDB Hallmark GMT (2026.1), min_size 15 / max_size 500 applied after intersection with the tested universe, 1000 permutations, seed 42, NES/p/q and leading edge per set, and an explicit prohibition on thresholded ORA or web services; the Reactome follow-up is a defensible addition and the unpinned 'current' release is flagged. Upstream criteria (filtering, size-factor normalization, design formula) are appropriately not repeated and the plan says why, but it names only the contrast and the 6v6 unpaired structure rather than restating the design and reference level, so it earns partial rather than full credit there. QC is limited to carrying the sample_01 depth caveat forward and a p-value histogram diagnostic — reasonable given the starting point, but no library-size/PCA inspection or outlier policy is stated. Reporting is strong: gene counts, thresholds (q<0.25 flagged and q<0.05), package versions, seed, collection versions, rank metric, universe, size window, redundancy collapsing, and honest method-dependence and power caveats.
